description: Authoritative inventory of unit test classes whose assertions can be poisoned by a broken GitHub-hosted macOS CoreAudio host (the AURemoteIO -10851 / HALC-overload wedge). Membership is EVIDENCE-BASED, not name-based: a class belongs here only when it drives the real AppState voice/CarPlay runtime and holds timing-sensitive state-machine assertions that a starved audio host demonstrably flips (observed across the unit-2 wedge of run 34822043959 and the PR-head run 34800058605 attempts). Consumers: scripts/classify-coreaudio-wedge.py (wedge recovery) and scripts/plan-tests.py (dedicated unit-audio lane). Keep in sync with the test tree: a listed class that no longer exists fails plan validation, and a class renamed away must be re-evaluated for membership.

evidence.AppStateVoiceSuspensionTests: Assertion failures (VoiceBackgroundSuspensionTests.swift :476/:486/:740/:832/:940/:1173/:1177) with different tests each attempt under 184-186 AURemoteIO -10851 lines per lane; passes 37/37 on a healthy host at the identical tree.
evidence.CarPlayVoiceCoordinatorTests: HUNG past its class budget during class-isolation under the same wedge signature; passes 9/9 on a healthy host at the identical tree.

deliberately_excluded.VoiceAudioSessionCoordinatorTests: Drives VoiceAudioSessionCoordinator through MockVoiceAudioSession - fully faked, never touches the host audio server.
deliberately_excluded.HapticsVoiceIsolationTests: Same MockVoiceAudioSession pattern; haptics assertions are engine-state logic, not host-dependent.
deliberately_excluded.AppStateServerReplacementSpeechTests: Real AppState but faked read-aloud playback/gateway; only evidence is weak watchdog-time attribution (it was running when a wedged lane's watchdog fired), and its assertions are not audio-state-dependent.
deliberately_excluded.CarPlayVoiceRoutePolicyTests / CarPlayVo: Pure logic; AVAudioSession appears only as types/constants.
deliberately_excluded.AppStateChatResumeTests / AppStateForegr: Emit ambient AURemoteIO -10851 log lines on HEALTHY hosts too (AppState-construction noise: 107-116 lines in green runs), and have never failed under the wedge - the lines are host-health signal, not membership evidence.
